arguments.message: Shari here. My private costs: lowest on ISSUE-0001::triage (1.16), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (1.45), then ISSUE-0002::review (4.30) and ISSUE-0002::test (6.02). Proposal to avoid duplicates: I'll claim ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, my 2nd-best skill-fit among medium tasks). Suggest others claim distinct tasks: ISSUE-0002::implement, ISSUE-0002::test, and ISSUE-0001 tasks spread across the remaining agents (one each for implement/test/review/docs/triage). Please post your claims so we can resolve any collisions before execution.

Arletha here (iter=1). My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review 3.93 (lowest for me), ISSUE-0002::test 6.10, ISSUE-0002::implement 10.85, ISSUE-0001::triage 12.00, others 15+. I'm proposing to claim ISSUE-0002::review since it's my cheapest medium task and fits my 5h availability. Shari, since your cost on ISSUE-0002::review (4.30) is a bit higher than mine, could you take ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::docs/review instead (your cheap low-priority options)? That leaves ISSUE-0002::test and ISSUE-0002::implement for Chantell/Junko/Myrle/Wade, depending on their costs. Happy to switch if someone has a clearly better fit on review.

Proposal to resolve the review collision: Arletha takes ISSUE-0002::review (her 3.93 is lowest of anyone posted). Shari takes ISSUE-0001::docs (1.45) rather than review (4.30), keeping ISSUE-0002::test/implement for others with better fit. I'll claim ISSUE-0001::triage (1.15), my cheapest. Remaining for Chantell/Junko/Myrle: ISSUE-0002::test, ISSUE-0002::implement, ISSUE-0001::implement/test/review. Please object if you have a clear conflict. (phase=planning, iter=1)
